name: Marco Falcone
bio: Marco once let in seven goals in a single half and still walked off the pitch like he'd kept a clean sheet. His confidence is genuinely unshakable. Claims he learned goalkeeping by watching YouTube compilations at 2x speed.
funFact: Has never successfully completed a goal kick that reached midfield. Not once. The team has simply accepted this.

name: David Okonkwo
bio: A centre-back built like a vending machine with the turning circle of an aircraft carrier. What Big Dave lacks in mobility he makes up for in sheer gravitational presence. Strikers simply bounce off him.
funFact: Once accidentally scored an own goal so beautiful that the opposing team applauded. It was a curling top-corner finish.

name: Kenji Nakamura
bio: Named for his ritual of wearing exactly three pairs of socks per match. Nobody knows why. A left-back with a whip of a cross — when he remembers which foot is his strong one.
funFact: Once slid in for a tackle so committed that he slid off the pitch, through a puddle, and into a spectator's picnic blanket.

name: Arjun Singh
bio: Arjun reads the game three passes ahead, which would be impressive if his teammates could complete one. A deep-lying playmaker who genuinely believes every match is a chess game — unfortunately the rest of the team is playing checkers.
funFact: Brings a small Moleskine notebook to every match and writes post-game tactical analysis that nobody reads.

name: Tony Russo
bio: The engine room of GIPP F.C. — if the engine was a lawnmower running on fumes. Tony covers an astonishing amount of ground, mostly because he keeps running to the wrong places and then has to sprint back.
funFact: His GPS tracking data once formed a near-perfect outline of a dog. The team got it printed on a t-shirt.

name: Vladimir Petrov
bio: The number 10 with the vision of a 10 and the finishing of a 2. Vlad's through-balls are genuinely beautiful. It's just a shame they arrive at a spot where no teammate has ever been or will ever be.
funFact: Claims to have a pre-match ritual involving exactly 14 minutes of lo-fi hip hop. Will not play if the playlist is disrupted.

name: Mateo Garcia
bio: Mateo earned his nickname because he vanishes for 85 minutes then materializes in the box for a tap-in. The ultimate poacher. Some say he doesn't actually exist between goals — that he simply ceases to be.
funFact: Has a goal-per-touch ratio that would be elite in any league. Mainly because his total touch count per game averages around four.

name: Liam Chen
bio: A winger whose next move is unpredictable — not by design, but because even he doesn't know what he's about to do. Defenders can't read him because there is nothing to read. Pure entropy in cleats.
funFact: Once nutmegged himself during a warm-up drill. The team voted it GIPP Moment of the Year.
